# VELIQ

> VELIQ is a global boutique web development and SEO agency operating across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and the United States.

## Services

- [Website Development](https://www.veliq.co/services/website-development): Custom website design and development with SEO built in from day one.
- [Website Support](https://www.veliq.co/services/website-support): Ongoing maintenance, updates, and technical support for existing websites.
- [SEO](https://www.veliq.co/services/seo): Technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content strategy to drive organic growth.
